description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Tectonic Split
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Tectonic Split.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Repeat.
